description: Defines the ScheduleCurrentPeriodParams class, which encapsulates parameters related to a loan schedule's current period, including amounts for interest, principal, fees, penalties, and other related data.

classes.name: ScheduleCurrentPeriodParams
classes.description: A data class for managing parameters of the current loan schedule period, including amounts for interest, principal, fees, penalties, and control flags.

methods.name: getEarlyPaidAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount paid early in the current period.

methods.name: plusEarlyPaidAmount
methods.description: Adds a specified amount to the early paid amount.

methods.name: minusEarlyPaidAmount
methods.description: Subtracts a specified amount from the early paid amount.

methods.name: getLastInstallment
methods.description: Retrieves the last installment period.

methods.name: setLastInstallment
methods.description: Sets the last installment period.

methods.name: isSkipCurrentLoop
methods.description: Checks if the current loop should be skipped.

methods.name: setSkipCurrentLoop
methods.description: Sets whether to skip the current loop.

methods.name: getInterestForThisPeriod
methods.description: Gets the interest amount for the current period.

methods.name: setInterestForThisPeriod
methods.description: Sets the interest amount for the current period.

methods.name: minusInterestForThisPeriod
methods.description: Subtracts an interest amount from the current interest for the period.

methods.name: getPrincipalForThisPeriod
methods.description: Gets the principal amount for the current period.

methods.name: setPrincipalForThisPeriod
methods.description: Sets the principal amount for the current period.

methods.name: plusPrincipalForThisPeriod
methods.description: Adds a principal amount to the current principal for the period.

methods.name: minusPrincipalForThisPeriod
methods.description: Subtracts a principal amount from the current principal for the period.

methods.name: getReducedBalance
methods.description: Returns the reduced outstanding balance.

methods.name: setReducedBalance
methods.description: Sets the reduced outstanding balance.

methods.name: getFeeChargesForInstallment
methods.description: Retrieves fee charges for the installment.

methods.name: setFeeChargesForInstallment
methods.description: Sets fee charges for the installment.

methods.name: minusFeeChargesForInstallment
methods.description: Subtracts fee charges from the current fee charges.

methods.name: getPenaltyChargesForInstallment
methods.description: Retrieves penalty charges for the installment.

methods.name: setPenaltyChargesForInstallment
methods.description: Sets penalty charges for the installment.

methods.name: minusPenaltyChargesForInstallment
methods.description: Subtracts penalty charges from the current penalty charges.

methods.name: fetchTotalAmountForPeriod
methods.description: Calculates total amount for the current period including principal, interest, fees, and penalties.

methods.name: isEmiAmountChanged
methods.description: Checks if the EMI amount has been changed.

methods.name: setEmiAmountChanged
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating if the EMI amount has been changed.

methods.name: getInterestCalculationGraceOnRepaymentPeriodFraction
methods.description: Returns the interest calculation grace period fraction.
